verdict.rationale: Abacum documents its own permission system: group-based role assignment for managing user permissions across the workspace, plus edit history on models and spaces. It also mentions bottom-up budget inputs, which implies contributors outside finance. However, nothing shows permissions can be scoped to a department or dimension so a budget owner sees and edits only their own numbers. missing for 10: explicit department- or dimension-level data scoping, documentation of edit-versus-view restrictions per budget owner, independent or hands-on corroboration.
